verdict.rationale: LangGraph's source is hosted in a public GitHub repository (github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph), and LangChain's docs index describes its packages as "open source" under an /oss/ docs path. However, no evidence names the actual license or its terms, so the "open license" half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: the specific license name and terms (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), and independent corroboration of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents.
Documentation for LangSmith, Fleet, and our open source packages.
